one_liner: SEO and marketing data platform (backlinks, keywords, SERPs, rank tracking, site audit) with a REST API v3 that only works on paid plans.
notes: Direct API v3 uses a Bearer API key created in Account settings (owners/admins only). OAuth 2.0 (authorization code + PKCE) is also documented, but only for apps in the Ahrefs Connect partner program, which needs an application and an approval review; it is listed in auth_methods because the official docs offer it. Access: the docs say the API is on 'eligible paid plans' and free test queries are for 'users on any paid plan'; the help center says all new applications need a Lite or higher subscription. There is no free or trial path to API credentials (the free 'Public' endpoints only return crawler IP ranges), so access=paid_plan and verdict=blocked. The hosted MCP server (api.ahrefs.com/mcp/mcp) is official but also needs Lite or higher, and the terms forbid calling it from custom scripts. Breadth is moderate: many read-only report endpoints (all data endpoints are GET), plus some writes through the Management endpoints for Rank Tracker projects and keyword lists. The docs HTML pages are a single-page app and return 404 to some fetchers (WebFetch), so evidence uses the .md/llms.txt versions the site publishes; the help-center quote has <b> markup inside the sentence, so the quote is cut before it.
